title: Trunk Links and Native VLAN
description: Configure an 802.1Q trunk link on a switch port and understand how VLANs are carried across trunk links. Configure the native VLAN and add a description to document the uplink.
scenario: SW1 already has VLANs 10, 20, and 99 configured. GigabitEthernet0/1 connects to an upstream router. You need to configure it as a trunk so all VLANs can be routed. GigabitEthernet0/2 connects to another switch and must also be a trunk.

tasks.description: Configure GigabitEthernet0/1 as a trunk port

check.description: Gi0/1 must be in trunk mode

tasks.description: Add a description 'Uplink to Router' on GigabitEthernet0/1
tasks.hint: interface GigabitEthernet0/1 → description Uplink to Router

check.description: Gi0/1 must have description 'Uplink to Router'

tasks.description: Configure GigabitEthernet0/2 as a trunk port

check.description: Gi0/2 must be in trunk mode
